{{Quote|Have you seen the latest on Senator Herbin?|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="no prisoners" />}}
'''Herbin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="no prisoners" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> after having been [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a [[Herbin's spouse|individual]] for some time, Herbin began cheating on his spouse with a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] [[Unidentified actress|actress]]. The affair was widely publicized over [[HoloNet News and Entertainment]].<ref name="no prisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
Herbin was mentioned in the [[2009]] novel, ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'', by [[Karen Traviss]], which was part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' multimedia project.<ref name="no prisoners" />
